One comment

South Wind

This is not the well-known tune played by the likes of Joanie Madden but a slow reel from the album Celtic Moods 1 and composed by Biddy Blyth, Mike Trim and Marc Duff. Marc Duff plays it on Low F whistle and I transcribed it because I think it’s a lovely tune!! Unusual but great little album with the likes of Fred Morrison and members of Capercaillie contributing.

↳ Posted by Mikethebook on February 2nd, 2018.
